messages:
Jae: Quick idea: preview API should return a small 'stability_score' (0-1) + 'confidence' and a suggested fallback action. If stability_score < 0.25 and mode=block, prevent auto-promote.
Noah: What signals? p95 delta, 5xx delta, and throughput loss. Keep it cheap to compute.
Priya: Add min_sample cutoff; if samples < min, return confidence=0 and reason 'insufficient_data' (show yellow banner in UI).
Jae: API sketch: POST /v1/configs/preview {config, traffic_pct, mode} -> {stability_score, confidence, blocked, reasons:[...], fallback:"route:latency-pool, batch:8", preview_id}.
Noah: Emit telemetry event preview.stability_check with tags tenant_id, preview_id, sample_count, stability_score, confidence.
Priya: Console UX: inline one-line reason + link to expanded trace (p95 chart). Provide 'apply fallback' CTA that creates a follow-up canary using the fallback params.
ops-bot: Ops note: if blocked && stability_score < 0.1, auto-open a ticket to owning-channel with preview_id and suggested mitigations. Rate-limit tickets per tenant.
Jae: Security: force-promo requires two approvers and must record approver IDs in audit log.
Noah: Implementation plan: control-plane computes score from recent windows, persists preview snapshot, and returns preview_id for replay. Priya to own UI.
Priya: Will draft RFC and mock.
Jae: Thanks — tagging @Noah and @Priya for follow-up.
